## Summary

## Scientific and provenance checklist

- [ ] I recorded the source URL/DOI for material that influenced this change.
- [ ] I recorded license or permission status in `THIRD_PARTY.yml` when relevant.
- [ ] I did not copy unlicensed code, prose, data, or pixels.
- [ ] Any clean-room implementation is based on an independently written requirement.
- [ ] Example data is synthetic or rights-cleared and clearly labeled.
- [ ] Statistical or semantic changes include a human-review note.
- [ ] Tests cover data fidelity and expected artifacts.
- [ ] No secrets, private submissions, or restricted research data are included.
